meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中运行本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local models and manage model library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run local LLMs in containers and manage model libraries

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以把任务交给本地 Ollama 模型处理：它会多出「列出已安装模型」和「向指定模型发提示并取回回答」两个工具；若开启管理开关，还能拉取、删除、查看模型及查看运行中的模型。
howto.when: 当你说出“Ollama”或要求用本地模型完成某件事时触发。安装完成后，代理即可通过这几个工具调用本机 Ollama。

say.text: 用 ollama 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: 代理会列出模型并调用 generate 回答
开启管理工具后，代理会调用 pull_model

say.text: 哪些 ollama 模型正在内存中运行？
say.note: 代理会调用 list_running 查看

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can delegate tasks to local Ollama models. It gains tools to list installed models and send prompts to a chosen model, plus optional pull/delete/show/list-running tools when the admin flag is enabled.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "Ollama" or ask to use a local model for something. Once installed, the agent can call these tools against your local Ollama daemon.

say_en.text: Use ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: The agent lists models and calls generate for the answer
With admin tools on, the agent calls pull_model

say_en.text: Which ollama models are loaded in memory right now?
say_en.note: The agent calls list_running to check
